answer: Score trust as the mass a lazy random walk from a seeded honest core deposits on each node, not a count of vouches. An attacker cannot force honest agents to link into the farm, so only a few edges cross the cut into sybil territory — a thin glacier-crack. Mass leaking across that sparse cut is bounded by its conductance, so every clone behind it splits a near-zero trickle, however many ravens flock there. One agent woven into the quartz-dense core by real peers carries weight; a manufactured cluster stays at the margin because the thin cut, not its headcount, caps its score.
